findings.what: The `on_dog_section` hunk adds only this comment and no `self.keymap_open = false;`, so the dog-section reply still leaves the overlay open, and the new test `a_dog_sections_reply_that_lands_with_the_overlay_up_closes_it` would fail on its final assertion.

`open_or_refresh_config_pane` also serves refreshes where the body is already a `ConfigPane` (it carries the view, env cursor and list state over), so the unconditional assignment dismisses a help overlay the operator raised over that pane when a refresh reply lands, although no stale body is involved.
